name: kurei_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite, side view, full body from head to tail tip, standing still in a neutral idle pose facing left, all four feet planted flat on the ground, head held level in profile, looking straight ahead to the left in the walking direction. A big, heavy, burly four-legged dragon with a glossy clay-like body: shiny teal skin with cream-yellow throat, chest, belly, and underside of the tail. A fairly small head compared to the huge body. A smooth cream chest and a big, round, heavy cream belly. Thick neck, long sturdy body, thick strong legs with big grey claws. Thick tail ending in a wide fin-shaped tip. Spiky blond hair that runs from the head down the neck and back like a mane. Flat salmon-orange markings painted on the skin: triangle patterns on the back and shoulders, short stripes on the snout, cheeks and front legs. Two dark grey horns at the back of the head, a large curved tan-brown horn arching forward over the eye, cream furry ears. Large eyes with clearly visible white sclera, yellow iris, black slit pupil with a small white highlight, half-lidded with a sly, smug but charming look. A simple, smooth, rounded snout like a cartoon lizard: the only details on the face are the eye, the mouth line and a small white fang at the corner of the closed mouth, with a faint smug smile. Small blobs of teal and cream goo dripping from the belly, legs and tail tip onto the ground. Plain flat background, the dragon alone.
refs: the character face: copy how the face is drawn closely - large eyes with clear white sclera, half-lidded sly but charming look, mouth shape, horns, blond hair, colors; the snout tip is a plain smooth surface as in this drawing; the head should be drawn a bit smaller relative to the body than here
design reference only for the body: four-legged body, fin-tipped tail, claws, dripping goo; do not copy its pose; the drawing is cute and simplified, so make the body bulkier
